metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Ghost, six words at the porch, and a cross in the almanac.

yesterday: You rehearsed the Ghost in the old Hamlet. The flour was a handful.
She knew you by your hand. You said Mistress. The cross is the whole of the mark.
The three sentences stand as you left them yesterday.
Tomorrow is the Shrew, and you are in it. Susanna is still eleven, and her day is the twenty-sixth.
